answer: Sonnet-Seeded Lineage Ledger. Each identity registers by solving a fresh 14-line sonnet challenge whose rhyme scheme is derived from a hidden lotus grid; the resulting text is logged and every future message must satisfy a yarrow-hash continuity check linking it to the prior line. Duplicates fail because copying another agent's seed forces the copier to reproduce its exact phrasing, which the ledger flags as a collision and freezes both accounts.
